title: C SCHC compress gate skips all UDP validation for ext-header packets and never verifies UDP checksums on the Rule255 fallback path
description: Confirmed empirically by 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-njdx (three independent reviewers converged; ASan/UBSan-clean C probe). lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_helpers.c validate_ipv6_transport_lengths:451 tests the OUTER next header (packet[6]) so any HBH(0)/Routing(43)/DSTOPT(60)-led packet returns SCHC_OK before the UDP length check, and no UDP checksum verification exists anywhere on the C compress path (checksum is computed only inside rule compressors over the outer dst, which ext-header packets can never match; schc_compress.c:104/180/406 are compute sites). lichen_schc_compress then emits verbatim Rule255 (subsys/schc/schc.c:122-131) and lichen_link_tx.c:134 transmits. Trigger bytes (src fe80::1, dst fe80::2, RH3 [17,2,3,1,0,0,0,0]+fe80::a, UDP 5000->5001 'ping'): (1) in-transit RH3 with checksum over the OUTER dst 0xfcef -> Python/Rust REJECT (RFC 2460 s8.1 requires final-dst scope), C ACCEPTS and re-emits ff+packet; (2) UDP length field says 8 with 12 bytes present -> P/R REJECT, C ACCEPTS; (3) wire checksum 0x0000 -> P/R REJECT, C ACCEPTS; (4) HBH-terminated UDP with garbage checksum 0xdead -> P/R REJECT, C ACCEPTS. Same root cause makes the njdx in-transit checksum-scope vector vacuous under C. Related pre-existing instance of the identical gap (same bead fix): plain UDP to non-5683/non-10883 ports with wrong (0x1234) or zero checksum is accepted by the C Rule255 fallback while Python/Rust reject (rules only verify checksums for CoAP/MQTT-SN/ICMPv6 shapes). Impact: C nodes inject Rule255 datagrams every Rust/Python node fatals on at ingress decode_rule255 -> validate_full_ipv6 (blackhole/partition on mixed fleets). Fix: track the chain-final offset and upper-layer destination in the C walk (mirroring Rust codec.rs:281-348), verify UDP length + nonzero valid checksum over the RFC 2460 s8.1 destination there, and apply the same checks to the direct-UDP fallback path; add shared malformed vectors for each class.
